verdict.rationale: A probe found an OpenAPI spec served at nethunt.com/api/openapi.json, which points to a first-party programmatic API, and the site also mentions webhooks and MCP-assistant connectivity. Nothing shows that the API matches the UI's many features, such as views, bulk updates, merging duplicates, pipeline customization, automations, comments and tasks. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for UI features, endpoint documentation content, an explicit API-parity claim, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant to NetHunt in a few clicks.
